title: Dual-pathway proton transport blockade enabling high areal loading aqueous zinc metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1006-1017
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06001J, Paper
Xiaofeng Cui, Limin Liu, Xinyang Li, Na Gao, Jie Feng, Dandan Yin, Lanya Zhao, Hetong Qi, Xiangyang Li, Hongyang Zhao, Chunhui Xiao, Shujiang Ding, Wei Yu
A zwitterionic hPDMP membrane is engineered to simultaneously block grotthuss-type proton hopping and vehicle-type water-assisted transport, enabling stable Zn metal cycling and ultrahigh-loading Zn‖I2 pouch-cell operation.
